#
# --- U872 PUNPCKLBW / PUNPCKLWD / PUNPCKLDQ mm, mm/m32 (NP 0F 60/61/62, SDM Vol2B): a doubleword source.
# Before U872 it was read as 8 bytes: #PF on a doubleword in the last 4 bytes, #AC for one at offset 4
# (the i5-13600K: neither). The 66 forms read m128 (#PF across the end on both).
.byte 0x0f, 0x60, 0x86, 0xfc, 0x7f, 0x00, 0x00 | st0=FFFF:8877665544332211 m+0xFFFC=A1B2C3D4
.byte 0x0f, 0x61, 0x86, 0xfc, 0x7f, 0x00, 0x00 | st0=FFFF:8877665544332211 m+0xFFFC=A1B2C3D4
.byte 0x0f, 0x62, 0x86, 0xfc, 0x7f, 0x00, 0x00 | st0=FFFF:8877665544332211 m+0xFFFC=A1B2C3D4
.byte 0x0f, 0x60, 0x46, 0x04 | cpl=3 rflags=0x40202 st0=FFFF:8877665544332211 m+0x8004=A1B2C3D4
.byte 0x0f, 0x61, 0x46, 0x04 | cpl=3 rflags=0x40202
.byte 0x0f, 0x62, 0x46, 0x04 | cpl=3 rflags=0x40202
.byte 0x0f, 0x60, 0x46, 0x02 | cpl=3 rflags=0x40202
.byte 0x0f, 0x62, 0x46, 0x01 | cpl=3 rflags=0x40202
